mapper.update: UPDATE admin_case SET case_status='closed',active_case_key=NULL,closed_by_admin_user_id=#{operatorId},resolution_code='cancelled',resolution_summary=#{reason},closure_checklist_json=#{facts},closed_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND case_status='pending'
mapper.select: SELECT nickname FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.sql:
FROM (
SELECT a.id,'sku_audit' source_type,CASE WHEN a.action_type IN ('create','update') THEN 'sku' ELSE 'sku_status' END category,a.sku_id,s.sku_code,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.proposed_snapshot_json,'$.fields.prop_name')) prop_name,s.factory_id,f.factory_name,s.asset_type,a.action_type action_type,a.audit_status,a.submitted_at,a.reviewed_at,u.nickname applicant_name,a.version,a.apply_remark apply_remark,COALESCE(a.initial_sn_quantity,a.initial_stock_quantity) initial_quantity,NULL quantity,NULL quantity_delta,NULL related_sku_audit_id FROM prop_sku_audit a JOIN prop_sku s ON s.id=a.sku_id JOIN factory_profile f ON f.id=s.factory_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.applicant_user_id
UNION ALL
SELECT a.id,'sn_adjustment' source_type,'inventory' category,a.sku_id,s.sku_code,s.prop_name prop_name,s.factory_id,f.factory_name,s.asset_type,a.adjustment_type action_type,a.audit_status,a.submitted_at,a.reviewed_at,u.nickname applicant_name,a.version,a.apply_remark apply_remark,NULL initial_quantity,a.requested_quantity quantity,NULL quantity_delta,a.related_sku_audit_id FROM prop_sn_adjustment_audit a JOIN prop_sku s ON s.id=a.sku_id JOIN factory_profile f ON f.id=s.factory_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.applicant_user_id
UNION ALL
SELECT a.id,'stock_adjustment' source_type,'inventory' category,a.sku_id,s.sku_code,s.prop_name prop_name,s.factory_id,f.factory_name,s.asset_type,a.adjustment_type action_type,a.audit_status,a.submitted_at,a.reviewed_at,u.nickname applicant_name,a.version,a.reason apply_remark,NULL initial_quantity,NULL quantity,a.quantity_delta,a.related_sku_audit_id FROM prop_stock_adjustment_audit a JOIN prop_sku s ON s.id=a.sku_id JOIN factory_profile f ON f.id=s.factory_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=a.applicant_user_id
UNION ALL
) merged WHERE 1=1 AND category=#{reviewQueryDTO.category}

AND audit_status='pending' GROUP BY category
